summary: Frontend-only verification of new KoalaStudio (Creator > Studio). All UI elements, data-testids, and interactions verified PASS: 16-pad grid, pad selection (green ring), toolbar (mic/auto-chop/resample), Hold-FX bar (all 5 FX engage/disengage with orange highlight), FX amount slider, sequencer toggle, BPM input (clamps to 220 from 999), step cells per selected pad row, Stem mixer (4 stems + master sliders/mutes), Pad config (route/ADSR/filter/pitch), Search overlay opens, search returns 7 iTunes results for 'eminem'. CRITICAL FAIL: clicking a search result still triggers the webpack-dev-server-client-overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors: Unable to decode audio data' — the fix in SamplerEngine.decodeArrayBuffer is incomplete because modern decodeAudioData ALSO returns a Promise that rejects in parallel with calling the error callback; that returned promise rejection is unhandled. The toast does fire correctly ('Couldn't decode that audio (may be DRM/CORS)'), but the dev overlay appears too.

action_items: CRITICAL: Patch SamplerEngine.decodeArrayBuffer to also swallow the Promise returned by ctx.decodeAudioData. The modern API rejects the returned Promise in parallel with invoking the error callback. Suggested fix: const p = this.ctx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer.slice(0), resolve, () => resolve(null)); if (p && typeof p.catch === 'function') p.catch(() => resolve(null)); — that catches both legacy + modern surfaces and prevents the unhandled rejection that triggers the dev overlay.

Alternative/extra safety: in KoalaStudio.sampleFromTrack, also wrap the fetch+arrayBuffer+loadBufferIntoPad chain in a single try/catch that swallows DOMException 'EncodingError', and add a window 'unhandledrejection' guard for 'Unable to decode audio data' messages.
critical_code_review_comments: SamplerEngine.decodeArrayBuffer only catches the legacy callback rejection. The Promise-returning form of decodeAudioData (which all modern browsers expose) still rejects — that unhandled rejection drives the runtime overlay. This is the exact bug the previous turn claimed to have fixed; the fix is incomplete.

KoalaStudio.js is 590 lines, still under the 700 guideline but several sub-panels (Stem Mixer, Pad Config, Sequencer, Search overlay) could be extracted to /pages/studio/ sub-components for maintainability.

Sequencer loop in useEffect recreates the interval whenever `steps` changes (because steps is a dep) — that resets the 1/16-note timing on every step toggle while playing. Consider using a stepsRef.current ref and dropping `steps` from the dep array to keep timing stable.
engineRef.current?.pads[selected] is accessed directly in render (padCfg). Because engineRef has no React state binding, padCfg may be stale until force() is called. Works in practice but is fragile.
MediaRecorder uses hardcoded 'audio/webm' mime type — fails on Safari (no webm). Add a feature-check fallback to 'audio/mp4' for the mic-sample and resample flows.

context_for_next_testing_agent: KoalaStudio (Creator > Studio) is fully wired. The single remaining bug is that decodeAudioData's modern Promise rejection is NOT caught in SamplerEngine.decodeArrayBuffer — the runtime overlay (#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay) appears when an iTunes preview fails CORS decoding. Reproduce: localStorage.pp_lane='creator', navigate to Studio, click Sample Track, search 'eminem', click any result. The toast appears AND the overlay appears. Fix is one-liner: also .catch() the Promise returned by ctx.decodeAudioData. All other 17 flows (pads, FX toggle, sequencer, BPM clamp, step toggle, stem mixer, pad config, search, back) verified PASS.
rca of the issue: MDN: 'AudioContext.decodeAudioData' has both a callback-based (legacy) and a Promise-based (modern) signature. When invoked with success/error callbacks AND failure occurs, modern browsers still reject the returned Promise in addition to firing the error callback. SamplerEngine.decodeArrayBuffer wraps only the callback surface (`resolve(null)` on error callback) but ignores the returned Promise — so the rejection becomes an unhandled promise rejection, which webpack-dev-server-client-overlay surfaces as 'Uncaught runtime errors: Unable to decode audio data'. Mitigation: capture the returned promise and attach .catch(()=>resolve(null)).
